definitions.explanation: Each station along a railway line. Most commonly seen in the compound {各駅停車|かくえきていしゃ} ('local train', literally 'stops at every station') and announcements about service stops.

examples.japanese: {各駅|かくえき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{停|と}まる。
{各駅|かくえき}{停車|ていしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧。
examples.english: The local train takes a long time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{急|いそ}いでいない→急ぐ：01191_isogu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{各駅|かくえき}{停車|ていしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}って→乗る：00511_noru⟧⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんだ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: Since I wasn't in a hurry, I took the local train and enjoyed the scenery.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{各|かく}→各〜：00449_kaku⟧ (each) + ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧ (station). Outside the fixed compound {各駅|かくえき}{停車|ていしゃ}, it appears in service notices about which stations a train serves.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {各駅|かくえき}{停車|ていしゃ}: local train (stops at every station)
- {各駅|かくえき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{停|と}まる: to stop at every station
- {各駅|かくえき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{掲示|けいじ}→掲示：02838_keiji⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: posted at every station

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{普通|ふつう}{列車|れっしゃ}→普通列車：21610_futsuuressha⟧: local train — synonym of {各駅|かくえき}{停車|ていしゃ}, used by JR
- ⟦{快速|かいそく}→快速：09213_kaisoku⟧: rapid service — skips smaller stations
- ⟦{急行|きゅうこう}→急行：01386_kyuukou⟧: express — stops at fewer stations than ⟦{快速|かいそく}→快速：09213_kaisoku⟧
- ⟦{特急|とっきゅう}→特急：01476_tokkyuu⟧: limited express — stops at the fewest stations
